status: approved production direction; Crisp Take 1 neural performances receive an intentionally extreme handheld-radio treatment and play at 75% of the prior runtime level

source.referenceLine: Fourteen... Ward on dispatch. I have you at Pinewood. Restore emergency circuits A through C. Verify the east freight elevator. Then... clear the property. Keep this channel open.

performance.core: professional overnight dispatcher maintaining control while increasingly frightened
performance.cadence: hesitant pauses and short controlled breaks; fear should leak through composure rather than become panic
performance.intensity: tense and scared, restrained rather than theatrical
performance.arc: begin grounded and procedural, then let pauses and urgency increase as Renee realizes Pinewood is responding to her and imitating her voice

radioProcessing.intent: make Renee unmistakably sound like a real voice fighting through a cheap handheld walkie-talkie speaker, even at the cost of pristine fidelity
targets: strong small-speaker presence and midrange bite
clearly audible transmission grit and limited bit depth
obvious squelch bursts at transmission edges
75 percent of the previous runtime playback gain
avoid: subtle radio coloration that can disappear in the game mix
processing so supernatural that Renee becomes confused with PCAS or fake-Renee
